title: Automatic packed-format pseudo-review and pre-rotation truncation leave deterministic ransomware gaps
evidence: Valid authenticated state rollback and key+state deletion while the enrolled witness survived were refused; coherent replacement of every local authority remained explicitly capped at health 90.
A suffix-only entropy-8 .zip and deterministic 50-percent alternating encryption were scored by the new fixed-window path.

A new entropy-8 .zip beginning with four ZIP magic bytes produced no candidates or alerts. Its first cycle reported unproved_exclusions=1 and health 75; one automatic unchanged cycle cleared the uncertainty and returned complete=true at the module's maximum local-authority health 90.

A ten-entry inert directory stream with limit five selected only f00-f04 for epochs 0 through 11. _fair_directory_entries truncates before sorting and rotation, so f05-f09 can never enter the rotation set.
Large-file range misses, content-budget exhaustion, and traversal truncation remain honestly below health 100.
controls_held: Bounded recursive no-reparse traversal and exact object/ancestry holds.
Full-file streaming through 8 MiB and non-green unpredictable range proofs above 8 MiB.
Fixed-window strided entropy scoring and authenticated changed/missing transitions.
Local high-water rollback/deletion refusal and an explicit software-only freshness cap.
recommendation: Require bounded structural validation and authenticated operator/policy approval before a new high-entropy container can become excluded; an unchanged automated tick is not review. Rotate before truncation using a durable per-directory continuation/journal cursor or bounded selection over the complete namespace, persist restart-safe progress, and expose oldest-unseen age while retaining all existing incomplete-coverage caps.

title: Independent custody freshness is not production-wired and has no safe local-ahead replay
evidence: Post-completion hard-link mutation remained possible in an unprotected inert source fixture, but capture was typed captured_unverified, refresh failed, durable topology uncertainty remained, and health was 65.

Independent-authority regressions refused complete local deletion and coherent rollback as local-behind; local-only substitution remained explicitly health 70 with prior_history_may_have_been_erased=1.
ModuleManager discovers SmartDeception via cls(), its constructor and register() both default high_water=None, and no production binder or factory injects an IndependentHighWater.
The module's smart-deception-custody domain is absent from Personal Sentinel's default allowed domains, so the shipped authority rejects it unless separately customized.

An inert authority outage after a locally durable event produced provisional-offline. After authority recovery, restart classified the same authenticated local state local-ahead and remained recovery-required because no exact pending CAS replay exists.
controls_held: Original bounded honeytoken read, exclusive restage, and bounded dedup controls remain fixed.
Local chain/witness rollback, deletion, digest mutation, capacity, eviction, and same-sequence race paths remain fail-closed or non-green.
Required Windows ACLs are applied and verified before packaged capture succeeds.
Userspace evidence is typed captured_unverified and topology uncertainty is durable.
Software-only authority and absent WORM replication are explicitly capped below green/high assurance.
recommendation: Wire a reviewed authority provider through ModuleManager and enroll the smart-deception-custody domain in the configured authority policy. Add a durable two-phase external-transition outbox and restart reconciliation that retries only an exact one-step local-ahead CAS whose predecessor matches the authenticated remote head; refuse forks, gaps, identity changes, and ambiguous resets. Retain captured_unverified, ACL proof, conservative health caps, terminal reserve, and durable topology/loss events.
assurance_boundary: Same-host administrator-resistant evidence preservation remains impossible with local userspace files alone. The module now discloses that limit; actual preservation requires production-wired independent monotonic authority and separately administered append-only/WORM or kernel-sealed custody.
